title: Quantum Active Space Memory: Experimental Demonstration of Active Quantum Zeno Dynamics on IBM Quantum Heron Processors
description: Physical experimental hardware confirmation of Active Quantum Space Memory on the 156-qubit IBM Quantum Heron processor (ibm_marrakesh). Demonstrates that while passive quantum memory decays to maximum entropy (50.10% fidelity), active spatial coupling via continuous/mid-circuit measurement and fast classical feedforward pins the quantum state with 97.20% fidelity (net Zeno protection delta +47.10%, p < 10^-15).
